scope: A complete portable numerical query over the reviewed aggregate facts, not metadata-only output and not a mirror of every raw operational worksheet.
dependencies: Python standard library only. Reproduction makes no network requests and executes no spreadsheet formulas.
inputs: The complete qualification input retains all 26 current report receipts, 25 distinct report counties, 29 native county identities, reviewed native statistics and historical fields, and all 228 observed registration-affiliation rows from the independent six-page PDF review.
source_review: All original bodies were retained privately with verified byte counts, SHA-256 and TLS. Both complete PDF text-engine outputs and all 20 physical-page renders/local OCR outputs were retained; two empty text outputs are not numerical validation. All seven workbooks independently match a separate OOXML parser across all 753 nonempty cached cells. Scanned/embedded-table numerical fields were reviewed from physical page images.
latest: Keep both Davis reports in the observation and receipt tables. Select its explicit November 5 report once for the county table; do not sum it with November 4.
scope_withholds: Cache fully processed, Garfield scanned/credited, Iron received, Kane processed, Millard daily-counted scope and San Juan returned/pending-adjudication values remain distinct observations, not generic counted totals. Daggett, Morgan, Piute and Wasatch lack declared ballot-statistics reports in the acquired menu.
registrations: Registration affiliations are not party votes or group-specific participation. Native same-report registration snapshots are not replaced with the separate November 2 PDF. Preserve all absent party cells and the parent's one-record Republican/Total arithmetic discrepancies.
missingness: CSV empty values and value_state=missing preserve native blanks/dashes. They are never invented zeros. Backend zero fields without published turnout statistics are not zero participation.
geography: Native map feature IDs and county names are not approved Census FIPS. All geographic joins, generic turnout approvals and map approvals remain false. Context22 and its verified deployment are unchanged.
omissions: Raw HTML/PDF/XLSX originals, personal/operational worksheets and source API scripts remain private. All reviewed numerical query inputs, tables, receipt facts, methods, tests and reproducible code are in complete-query.zip.
archive: All fixed and derived files are hashed in checksums.json. The ZIP contains the manifest, never itself; reproducible timestamps avoid nondeterministic wrappers.
